findings.classification: Existing 774 Camera redundant-authority / public aggregate encapsulation finding, independently traced at 95e; no new duplicate count.
findings.historical_record: historical/774/camera-findings.jsonl line 47 and camera CONTRACT247; original Camera author/revision/scope and normal-generation qualification retained.
findings.reasoning: BuildingPlan publicly retains stair recipes and resolved geometry independently; resolved geometry exposes its solids. landings() checks whether any solid for the flight owner has Landing role, then recompiles the current stair and filters each newly derived position by current occupied-cell membership; it does not match every returned landing to a particular retained solid identity or pose. Navigation consumes those returned positions and may reject a point that is not insertable. If one side of the public aggregate changes without the other, a returned position may describe a different flight from the retained solids, subject to its floor and navigation conditions.
findings.normal_path_and_limits: During selected initial resolve, landing_policy filters both generated landing data and corresponding landing solids using the same floor predicate; floors::resolve reads the same storeys/cells and changes only resolved geometry, before the flight solids are appended. The code appends an auxiliary crown landing when no occupied destinations remain; that deliberate physical arrival is not an occupied-storey portal. One-sided raw edit, changed cells and a surviving owner Landing are conditional source states; no normal editor route, installed bad asset, accepted fictional path, physical simulation or product failure was established. Prior camera F047 remains historical; this current read does not change its old count or authorize aliasing with unrelated geometry issues.
findings.repair_direction: After audit completion and implementation authorization, bind navigation destinations to accepted retained landing identities/poses or enforce a coordinated rebuild through a private aggregate. Preserve the distinction between occupied-floor landings and auxiliary crown arrival, existing support geometry and current native boundary semantics.
